text: {"label":"Relational Frame Theory: Conceptual Developments","definition":"Theoretical overviews, conceptual updates, and critiques of relational frame theory as an account of human language and cognition, including comparisons with verbal behavior development theory, naming, Skinner, and neuroscience.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on relational frame theory as a theory, its status, history, and future, rather than experimental studies of derived relational responding, equivalence relations, or theory of mind."}
